owned_invariants: Each layer 7 family (tribunal, rule transfer, cost ladder, antibody dialogue, detector adequacy and exclusion retest) is a WorkflowFamily with a spec, a host check that records exact predicates, and offline fixtures with their expected verdict. Only that host check certifies.
The failures the FailureDerivedRuleTransfer fixture trains on are the ones layer 6 gives as sample_failures, without their provenance.
boundaries: These families check in Python until they move to the Rust host.
Fixtures are offline examples, not live model trials.

score.level_basis: The layer 7 families, which still check in Python with the immune helpers of layer 6 and are moved to the host in a later slice. L4 production integration scope.

basis.G1: The module docstring states the role; the contract binds AuthorityEffect None and names every exported symbol. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond docs/plans/operads_redesign.md.
basis.G2: Exact: rationals are read with Fraction and floats are refused, and counts are exact integers. Not B: tested on examples, not proven.
basis.G3: A malformed reply or task is a typed candidate error, and a failed predicate is a refusal with its code. Not B: no closed table of error codes for this module.
basis.G4: D: executed regression and negative controls are source-bound. No implementation-mutation campaign was run on these bytes, so no mutation ratio is claimed. This is an explicit verification deficit, not an unassessed pass. The 870-test run, including pfp_core/tests/test_immune_parity.py, runs every layer 7 fixture.
basis.G5: Measured worst cyclomatic 33, cognitive 32, nesting 4; ceiling D, recorded D.
